spatial_claims.claim: B is a point on line AC, cutting it into segments AB and BC
AC is cut at B, so sq(AC) = sq(AB) + sq(BC) + 2*rect(AB,BC) by Prop. 2.4

No auxiliary points, triangles, circles, angles, or complex spatial figures are constructed. The entire proof operates on commensurability relations between areas (squares and rectangles on these segments).
